article_title: 任何编码 Agent 都适用的可复核工作流
core_theme: 把编码 agent 的仓库任务当成一条证据链：环境、权限、契约、证据四道关口，换成 Claude Code、Codex 还是 Copilot 都成立
reader_takeaway: 读者能看出 agent 说「已完成」时缺了哪一环，并知道每次委派要先固定环境、写清契约、分清权限、索要证据
summary_angle: 一张任务单沿斜向链条推进，依次经过环境、权限、契约、证据四道关口；被拒绝的支路变灰，通过的关口留下核对标记

information_blocks.source_anchor: 原文 Establish which environment owns the work：agent 的运行环境决定它能用哪些可执行文件与沙箱，SDK 不能从 IDE 推断
information_blocks.visual_idea: 链条起点的操作台与一层半透明隔离边界，任务单从边界内出发

information_blocks.source_anchor: 原文 Separate instructions from authority：运行时的 allow / ask / deny 才是权限，文档里的禁令只是提示
information_blocks.visual_idea: 一道闸门，一条支路被拦下变灰，主线继续向前

information_blocks.source_anchor: 原文 Make acceptance criteria observable：验收标准要写成客户端可观察的行为，并保留原有兼容路径
information_blocks.visual_idea: 清单卡钉在任务单上，写的是可观察结果而不是笼统的改好一点

information_blocks.source_anchor: 原文 Ask for evidence that matches the contract：结论要对应命令、版本、环境、结果和未覆盖的部分
information_blocks.visual_idea: 终点放着一张收据与放大镜，用来核对报告与契约是否对得上

main_metaphor: 彩铅手绘的四道关口流水线，一张任务单从环境出发，依次通过权限闸门、契约台与证据核对台
primary_subject: 一张写着任务的工作单
subject_action: 沿斜向链条依次穿过四道关口，其中一条支路停在闸门前变灰
composition: 斜向推进，主焦点是任务单，四道关口沿对角线依次排开，被拦下的支路在画面下方分叉
selected_style_prompt_descriptor: colored-pencil picture-book illustration, tactile strokes, gentle palette, warm narrative objects, soft educational tone
selected_style_reason: 用户未指定风格，本篇从风格池随机选中；流程与关口适合用绘本式温和手绘质感，把抽象约束画成可读物件
style_safety_note: 清单风格为泛类型描述，不涉及品牌、工作室或艺术家复刻
reference_strategy: 纯文本生成，不使用参考图
draft_goal: 先验证四道关口链条在 2.35:1 宽幅里是否读得通，任务单是否为唯一焦点
revision_targets: 关口顺序与标签是否清晰
被拒绝的支路是否一眼可辨
画面是否退化成装饰性科技氛围图
final_prompt: Use case: infographic-story. Asset type: wide cover infographic illustration for a Chinese tech blog article. Refine the existing cover direction: keep the same metaphor, the same four checkpoint labels and the same summary angle, only sharpen details and clean up the composition. Primary request: Create a wide cinematic infographic-story cover illustration that summarizes a practical engineering workflow. Theme: every coding agent task should be treated as a chain of evidence - four checkpoints a task must pass. The reader should quickly feel that an agent saying done is only a claim until environment, permission, contract and evidence line up. Summary angle: one work order travels diagonally through four checkpoint gates: environment, permission, contract, evidence; a rejected side path turns grey while the main path continues. Narrative flow: 3-beat process. In a 2.35:1 frame keep one dominant focal subject and 4 supporting narrative beats. Information blocks: (1) start of the chain, a tidy workbench inside a translucent isolation boundary, the task slip leaving the boundary, label 环境, numeral 1; (2) a checkpoint gate where one branch is stopped and turns grey while the main line passes through, label 权限, numeral 2; (3) a checklist card pinned to the work order showing observable acceptance results instead of vague promises, label 契约, numeral 3; (4) a receipt desk with a magnifying glass comparing the report against the contract, label 证据, numeral 4. Main metaphor: a colored-pencil drawn four-checkpoint pipeline carrying a single work order. Subject: one task slip with handwritten-looking marks on it, travelling along a diagonal chain through four gates. Composition/framing: diagonal progression, one clear focal subject, four checkpoints spread along the diagonal, the rejected grey branch splitting off in the lower part of the frame. Clean hand-drawn paper texture, no photography, no 3D render. Style/medium: combine isometric conceptual systems scene with the selected visual style descriptor: colored-pencil picture-book illustration, tactile strokes, gentle palette, warm narrative objects, soft educational tone. Stylized, polished, editorial, visually strong, and clearly readable as an infographic-style summary cover. Do not imitate a specific brand, studio, or living artist. Color palette: cream paper, graphite grey, amber, slate blue. Visible text policy: allow only the four short Chinese labels 环境 权限 契约 证据, plus the numerals 1 2 3 4. No poster title, no long sentences, no English slogans, no fake UI labels, no fake chart axes, no fake architecture node names. Constraints: no watermark, no prompt residue, no screenshots, no dashboards, no fake diagrams, no fake charts, no fake terminal output, no fabricated metrics, no unrelated icon collage, no decorative clutter. Avoid: floating microchips, meaningless code rain, neon skyline, generic robot poses, cyberpunk purple-blue glow, dense HUD overlays, real terminal windows, real dashboards, English slogans.
